description: This file defines a React component for the 'Projects' page of a frontend app, managing loading, creating, displaying projects, and handling user authentication state.

methods.name: loadProjects
methods.description: Fetches the list of projects from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Sends a request to create a new project with the specified name, updating the list upon success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication tokens and redirects to the auth page.
